title: Spectral Properties of the Logarithmic Laplacian with Indefinite Weights
summary: In this paper, we investigate a weighted eigenvalue problem driven by the Logarithmic Laplacian with indefinite weights. We prove the existence of an unbounded sequence of Lusternik-Schnirelman eigenvalues and show that the first eigenvalue is simple, with the associated eigenfunction having constant sign in the domain. In contrast, eigenfunctions corresponding to higher eigenvalues necessarily change sign.
